limits: Ten of eleven published goals have verified scoring-play references. Non-goals and Play Types remain unlabeled.

Recall uses ten verified references, not all eleven published goals.
Reference points are scoring-play frames, not exact puck crossings. Timing uses 12 fps local samples.
Two independent timing anchors narrowed the searches. Each final raw frame was checked visually against both cameras.
The sandbox excludes GX010003.MP4, a verified covered-lens Recording. The original NAS discovery metadata remains unchanged.
Generated matching scores and predicted times are not labels.
